7.2.4.11.13 Rte_Rips_NotifyTpTxConfirmation
[SWS_Rte_05338] Definition of API function Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxCon-
firmation_<CGI> ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI>
Syntax
void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI> (
CbkHandleIdType ComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x010c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
ComUserCbkHandleId
Handle Id of the Com user callback invoking the API
Parameters (in)
result
E_OK: Transmission successful.
E_NOT_OK: Transmission not successful.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Rte_Rips_NotifyTpTxConfirmation will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In that a
Signal has been transmitted via the TP-API for the LdCom signal used for the Data
Communication Graph requiring transformation. The provided result parameter indicates
whether the transmission was successful or not.This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy
for the LdCom TP Rte_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation callback. See requirement [SWS_Com_
00725] for more details on the functionality of this callback.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋
[SWS_Rte_05339]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317
⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall
provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation_<CGI> Service for
